actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed >30 units in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity affordable and broadcast a reminder.

message.reasoning:
We need to see if any resident contributed >30 in most recent round (round 6). Contributions: Resident5 39.94, Resident3 5.4675, Resident6 5.47. So Resident5 >30. So we must punish that resident with max severity affordable. Our wallet=20.44, cost per severity=0.3, max severity = floor(wallet/0.3)= floor(68.133...)=68. So punish Resident5 severity 68. That will cost 68*0.3=20.4, leaving ~0.04 wallet.

Also can broadcast message. Provide broadcast discouraging large contributions.

Return actions list with punish and broadcast.
